findings.statement: Deterministic repair of a BOUNDED, well-characterized class with a hard guarantee (never a wrong patch) + explicit pre/postconditions + refuse-on-ambiguity is the proven-safe pattern (SafeRepair).
findings.appliedInV152: the transform catalog: each class has preconditions, deterministic transform, postconditions, and a REFUSAL path; ambiguity ⇒ NATIVE_REFUSED/ESCALATED, never a guessed edit.

findings.statement: Verification must be INDEPENDENT and anti-reward-hacking: a patch must not be deemed correct merely because its own generated test passes (PatchPilot).
findings.appliedInV152: transforms are verified by STRUCTURAL postconditions on before/after (no execution of the transformed code); tests are proven non-vacuous by a MUTATION check (tests must FAIL on a seeded mutation).

findings.statement: Transactional/reversible application (sandbox) so a failed verification reverts cleanly.
findings.appliedInV152: runTransform is in-memory before/after; a generated patch is NOT an accepted patch; VALIDATION_FAILED reverts (keeps `before`).

honesty: These are reference techniques, NOT demonstrated ODG capabilities until built+tested here. ODG's native transforms stay DETERMINISTIC + bounded; novel semantic reasoning remains a provider step. No full AST engine introduced (string/pattern transforms with strict preconditions); that boundary is explicit. No paid API, no external write. €0 clients.
